title: Make the one-pass three-wake drain test independent of physical two-second budget
outcome: federation_m4_review_one_drain_pass_delivers_a_bounded_burst_without_waiting_a_tick_per_wake proves bounded burst work in one owned pass with controlled yield time.
acceptance: The test retains three ready wake requests, one owned drain tick/join and pending==0, with controlled clock input so scheduling/RPC/storage load alone cannot stop the pass early.
The production2s budget and bounded batch behavior are unchanged; a controlled expiry/resumption regression protects yielding, without retries, ignore or timeout inflation.
